[b][] Opening Up To The World [][/b]

[i]The rat people of the Bakagzi Desert of Shahmat have always been reclusive, rarely going outside of their desert and savannah homelands, and even when they did show up they were clad head-to-toe in robes and masks making it near impossible to get a good glimpse of what they actually look like. But it would appear that these reclusive and pacifistic peoples from Shahmat have begun to open up to the world, though not for the best of reasons...

A message goes out across the northern hemisphere of the world originating from deep in the Bakagzi Desert in Shahmat, a video on the internet showing a group of hundreds of short and hunched over figures huddling around a giant titanic dinosaur-looking creature that seems to be hurt or exhausted, unable to stand. The camera is somewhat shaky trying to focus on a person standing in front of it, beginning to speak in rudimentary English (or the equivalent language) muffled through their mask.

"Hello, foreigners. We know that many of you may be confused by this video and our intentions, but we assure you our intentions are peaceful. We only request help. We are the Kwelahn, and we reside in the Bakagzi Desert riding on the backs of our massive Tavariath." The camera pans over to the titanic creature. "But recently, our Tavariaths have begun to collapse on us and refuse to move, some of them even dying and creating massive refugee problems for other Shahdoms and Emirates. We are unable to ascertain why, and so we send out this video to the world to request help, for if our Tavariaths go extinct, our peoples will be unable to sustain themselves in this harsh environment. Please, we need your help, and thank you for listening." The video then goes silent, only giving coordinates for an oasis deep in the Bakagzi Desert.[/i]

[nation]British Republic of Bob[/nation]
(And other any nations that may wish to assist)
